findings.quote: especially along the coast, among the Etruscans and the Gauls
findings.problem: The Greek reads καὶ μάλιστα [τὴν παλαίαν], παρά τε τοῖς Τυρρηνικοῖς καὶ Γαλάταις. The words τὴν παλαίαν ('the old') are bracketed in the edition as doubtful or corrupt. 'Along the coast' is not in the Greek and silently smooths over the corrupt words.
findings.proposed_fix: especially among the Etruscans and the Gauls

units.note: The Greek is corrupt at [τὴν παλαίαν]. Do not resolve it silently; if the edition marks cruxes, flag it. The proposed fix only removes the invented 'along the coast'. The rest of the chapter matches the Greek, including the thousand pigs per sow.
